data.description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments at Chelsea Residences 2
data.display_address: Chelsea Residence by Damac, Maritime City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover a unique blend of sophistication and coastal charm at Chelsea Residences 2 in Dubai Maritime City by DAMAC. The project consists of three towers featuring thoughtfully designed apartments that combine style, functionality, and natural light for an elevated living experience.

Residents benefit from an extensive suite of facilities, including an infinity pool, fitness centers, cinema, and an immersive football simulator. The development also boasts multiple dining options with healthy menus and access to Chelsea Lion Beach, offering an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle.
